description: Transparent window on Windows — no visible background, pet sprites show correctly
steps: 1. Launch app. 2. Verify no visible window background — only pet sprites are rendered. 3. Screenshot confirms transparent background with pet visible.

description: Transparent window on macOS — same as P1-001 on macOS
steps: 1. Launch app on macOS. 2. Verify no visible window background — only pet sprites are rendered. 3. Requires physical macOS device.

description: Always-on-top — pet stays above all other windows
steps: 1. Launch app. 2. Open another application window. 3. Verify pet window remains on top. 4. Screenshot confirms pet visible above other windows.

description: Click-through on transparent areas — mouse events pass through to windows below
steps: 1. Launch app. 2. Simulate mouse click on transparent area of pet window. 3. Verify the click passes through to the window below (set_ignore_cursor_events).

description: Click detection on pet — mouse click on non-transparent pixels registers as pet interaction
steps: 1. Launch app. 2. Simulate mouse click on non-transparent pet sprite pixels. 3. Verify the click event is captured by the pet window.

description: Animation FPS — achieves target FPS consistently
steps: 1. Launch app. 2. Run animation loop for 5 seconds. 3. Measure actual FPS. 4. Assert FPS >= target (e.g. 30 FPS for idle).
1. Launch app. 2. Wait 10 seconds for initialization. 3. Measure process RSS memory. 4. Assert < 30MB.
